sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: North Carolina taxes trust income based on where beneficiaries live. The trust argues this violates the Commerce Clause.

paragraphs: The Supreme Court heard oral argument in this case on April 16, 2019.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: North Carolina wants to tax trust income based on beneficiary residency.
The trust wants to avoid state tax on its income.

paragraphs: North Carolina argues beneficiaries are true owners of trust income.

sections.heading: What the justices asked
